vocabulary.definition: originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native
vocabulary.example: The indigenous people of the island have a rich cultural heritage.

vocabulary.definition: a feeling of happiness, pleasure, or excitement
vocabulary.example: She danced with glee when she received the good news.

vocabulary.definition: to give something to someone, usually in your family, to continue after you
vocabulary.example: I plan to pass on my grandmother's ring to my daughter.

vocabulary.definition: a small problem or delay that slows things down
vocabulary.example: Facing a few bumps in the road, they managed to complete the project on time.

vocabulary.definition: the process of learning something by using only that and nothing else
vocabulary.example: Language immersion programs help students become fluent in a new language quickly.

vocabulary.definition: the ability to change between two or more languages when speaking
vocabulary.example: Growing up in a bilingual household, she mastered code-switching effortlessly.
